Channel.description:
Channel through which the complaint was registered — Resolución Anexo 1-A #7 (Anexo A).

Representative subset of Anexo A channel codes.
Channel.title: Channel

ComplainantAgeRange.description:
Age range bucket of the complainant.

No counterpart in Anexo 1-A. Used in lieu of the resolución's PII-bearing
fields (DNI, full name) for the May 25 sandbox. See ADR 0026.
ComplainantAgeRange.title: ComplainantAgeRange

ComplainantDocType.description:
Document-type code identifying the complainant — Resolución Anexo 1-A #2.

A representative subset of Anexo A document-type codes. The doc type acts
as a proxy for natural-vs-juridic person classification (DNI/CE/PASS imply
natural persons; RUC implies a juridic person).
ComplainantDocType.title: ComplainantDocType

Complaint.description:
The 15-field complaint payload as submitted by a supervised institution.

Field reconciliation against Resolución SBS N° 04036-2022 Anexo 1-A is
documented in ADR 0026 (Field-by-field reconciliation).

examples.description_text: Se realizó un cargo no autorizado por S/ 245.00 en la tarjeta de crédito el 10 de mayo. El cliente solicita reversa inmediata y revisión del estado de cuenta.

channel.description: Anexo 1-A #7 — Canal de ingreso. The channel through which the user registered the complaint with the institution. Subset of Anexo A channel codes.

complainant_age_range.description: Bucketed age range of the complainant. No counterpart in Anexo 1-A; used in lieu of the resolución's PII-bearing identity fields for the May 25 sandbox. See ADR 0026.

complainant_district.description: Anexo 1-A #13 — Ubicación geográfica. Six-digit INEI ubigeo (DDPPDD: department + province + district). The May 25 sandbox accepts the canonical 6-digit form; district digits may be '00' when only department + province is known per the resolución's department+province precision requirement. Example: 150100 = Lima/Lima with district unspecified. Use '999999' for complaints submitted from abroad.
complainant_district.title: Complainant District

complainant_doc_type.description: Anexo 1-A #2 — Tipo de documento de identidad del reclamante. Subset of Anexo A document-type codes. Acts as a proxy for natural-vs-juridic person classification.

complaint_id.description: Anexo 1-A #1 — Código del reclamo. Stable institution-assigned identifier. Pattern: institution-prefix, year, sequence.
complaint_id.title: Complaint Id

description_language.description: ISO 639 language code for description_text. No counterpart in Anexo 1-A; included to handle non-Spanish narratives. See ADR 0026.

description_text.description: Anexo 1-A #17 — Detalle completo de reclamo. The user's literal complaint statement as recorded by the institution. Free text, 10–8000 characters.
examples: Se realizó un cargo no autorizado por S/ 245.00 en la tarjeta de crédito.
description_text.title: Description Text

institution_id.description: SBS-assigned institution code (the Empresa código referenced by the resolución's Reportes section). Format: SBS-NNNN.
institution_id.title: Institution Id

motivo_code.description: Anexo 1-A #15 — Motivo del reclamo SBS. Subset of Anexo C codes; full list deferred to Part 11.

original_reference_id.description: Anexo 1-A #23 — Reclamo previo. Optional. When the user is re-filing a complaint that was previously resolved, this carries the complaint_id of the prior reclamo (which must also exist in the institution's database). Same pattern as complaint_id.
original_reference_id.title: Original Reference Id

product_category.description: Anexo 1-A #14 — Operación / servicio / producto del reclamo. Subset of Anexo B codes; full list deferred to Part 11.

received_date.description: Anexo 1-A #6 — Fecha de ingreso. The date on which the user submitted the complaint. ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD).
received_date.title: Received Date

resolution_status.description: Anexo 1-A #22 — Estado. Initial state on submission is typically 'pendiente'; 'atendido' or 'anulado' are set via the status PATCH endpoint over the complaint lifecycle.

severity.description: Severity tag set by the institution. No counterpart in Anexo 1-A; this is a prototype divergence used by the supervisory agents (Part 5+) for triage. See ADR 0026.

submission_method.description: Anexo 1-A #8 — Canal de operación. The channel through which the underlying operation that triggered the complaint occurred. Distinct from `channel` (which records the complaint-registration channel). Subset of Anexo A operation channels.

Complaint.title: Complaint

DescriptionLanguage.description:
ISO 639-1 / ISO 639-3 language code for the complaint narrative.

No counterpart in Anexo 1-A. Included to handle Quechua / Aymara / English
narratives that may appear in the Peruvian context. See ADR 0026.
DescriptionLanguage.title: DescriptionLanguage

MotivoCode.description:
Motivo del reclamo — Resolución Anexo 1-A #15 (Anexo C).

Representative subset of Anexo C motivos. The full code list is deferred
to Part 11.
MotivoCode.title: MotivoCode

ProductCategory.description:
Product / service / operation category — Resolución Anexo 1-A #14 (Anexo B).

Representative subset. The full Anexo B code list is deferred to Part 11.
ProductCategory.title: ProductCategory

ResolutionStatus.description:
Estado del reclamo — Resolución Anexo 1-A #22.

Resolución values: ``pendiente``, ``atendido``, ``anulado``. Mirrored here
in lowercase to match the resolución wording.
ResolutionStatus.title: ResolutionStatus

Severity.description:
Severity tag set by the institution at submission time.

No counterpart in Anexo 1-A; this is a prototype-level field used by the
supervisory agents (Part 5+) for triage. See ADR 0026 for the divergence
rationale.
Severity.title: Severity

SubmissionMethod.description:
Channel through which the underlying operation occurred — Resolución Anexo 1-A #8.

Distinct from :class:`Channel` (which records where the complaint was
*registered*). Representative subset of Anexo A operation channels.
SubmissionMethod.title: SubmissionMethod

description:
Body of ``POST /v1/complaints``.

A direct wrapper around :class:`Complaint` plus an idempotency hint that
institutions echo for at-least-once delivery semantics. The wire spec
requires the ``Idempotency-Key`` HTTP header on every POST; the optional
``client_submission_id`` here is a *body-level* hint useful for log
correlation and debugging.

client_submission_id.description: Optional. An institution-side correlation identifier echoed back in the 201 response and in the audit log. Distinct from the Idempotency-Key HTTP header which is required for at-least-once POST semantics.
client_submission_id.title: Client Submission Id
